discoveryFindings.scope: RCE record-level literal mentions; overlapping categories, historical assertions and monument-biased sample, not district frequencies.

nextBatch.scope: One contiguous canal street-side row, selected from source coverage; include ordinary and modern buildings.
selectionOrder: Diagnose existing failed De Wallen historic/modern transfer with explicit register frontage descriptions and dated archive evidence.
Choose a source-rich canal row, freeze representative and transition segments plus unused heldouts before recipe tuning.
deliverables: Inventory every native building in the row; record source-backed, uncertain and missing coverage separately.
Join direct BAG Pand links first; resolve VBO-to-Pand with official relationships; keep unresolved identities out of recipe assignment.
Retain assertions by source, building part, date and confidence; compare historical drawings against present-day facade evidence.
Compose each researched frontage from shared components: opening groups, trim, base/entrance, cornice, gable, roof and balcony assemblies.
Add a shared component only for a defining missing trait; favor bounded variants over bespoke geometry.
Review whole-row width, white-trim, window-group, cornice/gable mixture and balcony rhythm; keep exact registration secondary.
Require reference/render heldout comparison, independent failure review, live-game facade/LOD checks and scoped performance evidence.
nextBatch.acceptance: Reviewed street-side coverage only; no whole-city or whole-district claim from monument-only samples.

cityScaleHypothesis: Source-backed per-building recipes can scale through reusable components, but trial throughput, source ambiguity and row quality before committing to hand-authoring every Amsterdam canal house.

addressCohortFindings.method: Municipal adressering begins with exact street name plus space; append RCE descriptions only when municipal status is Rijksmonument and national number agrees. Counts are record-level literal mentions, not distinct facade probabilities.
addressCohortFindings.use: Prioritize shared components and source sampling. Do not apply ratios to all buildings or interpret absent words as absent features.
